title: B7-1 mediates podocyte injury and glomerulosclerosis through communication with Hsp90ab1-LRP5-beta-catenin pathway.
authors: Li, Jiemei; Niu, Jing; Min, Wenjian; Ai, Jun; Lin, Xu; Miao, Jinhua; Zhou, Shan; Liang, Ye; Chen, Shuangqin; Ren, Qian; Shen, Kunyu; Wu, Qinyu; Li, Xiaolong; Shen, Weiwei; Hou, Fan Fan; Liu, Youhua; Yang, Peng; Zhou, Lili
one_liner_zh: 该文研究B7-1介导足细胞损伤的Hsp90ab1-LRP5-beta-catenin信号通路，虽含分子对接但核心是疾病机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: Podocyte injury is a hallmark of glomerular diseases; however, the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. B7-1 is increased in injured podocytes, but its intrinsic role is controversial. The clinical data here revealed the intimate correlation of urinary B7-1 with severity of glomerular injury. Through transcriptomic and biological assays in B7-1 transgenic and adriamycin nephropathy models, we identified B7-1 is a key mediator in podocyte injury and glomerulosclerosis through a series of signal transmission to beta-catenin. Using LC-MS/MS, Hsp90ab1, a conserved molecular chaperone, was distinguished to be an anchor for transmitting signals from B7-1 to beta-catenin. Molecular docking and subsequent mutant analysis further identified the residue K69 in the N terminal domain of Hsp90ab1 was the key binding site for B7-1 to activate LRP5/beta-catenin pathway. The interaction and biological functions of B7-1-Hsp90ab1-LRP5 complex were further demonstrated in vitro and in vivo. We also found B7-1 is a novel downstream target of beta-catenin. Our results indicate an intercrossed network of B7-1, which collectively induces podocyte injury and glomerulosclerosis. Our study provides an important clue to improve the therapeutic strategies to target B7-1.
abstract_zh: 足细胞损伤是肾小球疾病的标志性特征；然而，其潜在机制仍不清楚。B7-1在受损足细胞中表达增加，但其内在作用存在争议。此处的临床数据显示，尿液中B7-1与肾小球损伤严重程度密切相关。通过在B7-1转基因和阿霉素肾病模型中进行转录组学和生物学分析，我们确定B7-1是通过一系列信号传递至β-catenin，在足细胞损伤和肾小球硬化中起关键介导作用。利用LC-MS/MS，Hsp90ab1（一种保守的分子伴侣）被鉴定为从B7-1向β-catenin传递信号的锚定蛋白。分子对接及后续突变分析进一步确定，Hsp90ab1 N端结构域中的K69残基是B7-1激活LRP5/β-catenin通路的关键结合位点。B7-1-Hsp90ab1-LRP5复合物的相互作用和生物学功能在体外和体内均得到进一步验证。我们还发现B7-1是β-catenin的一个新下游靶点。我们的结果表明，B7-1存在一个交叉网络，共同诱导足细胞损伤和肾小球硬化。本研究为改进靶向B7-1的治疗策略提供了重要线索。
